aviation_incidents.headline: UPS將27架MD-11貨機全數退役 改由波音767-300F接替
aviation_incidents.summary: UPS航空決定讓27架MD-11貨機全數退役，改由較省油的波音767-300F接替。2025年11月UPS2976號班機在路易維爾墜毀後，調查發現左翼發動機掛架故障；後續檢查及成本考量也影響決策。UPS將整批MD-11除帳，損失近1.4億美元；聯邦快遞則讓同型機復飛。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: UPS to retire all 27 MD-11 freighters and replace them with Boeing 767-300Fs
aviation_incidents.summary_en: UPS Airlines will retire all 27 MD-11 freighters and replace them with the more fuel-efficient Boeing 767-300F. After UPS Flight 2976 crashed in Louisville in November 2025, investigators found a failure in the left-wing engine pylon; further inspections and costs also shaped the decision. UPS wrote off the fleet at a loss of nearly $140 million, while FedEx returned its MD-11s to service.

aviation_incidents.headline: 四起航空事件涉及煞車轉向、起落架、行動電源及跑道偏出
aviation_incidents.summary: 彙整列出四起彼此獨立的航空事件，未提及事件間有關聯。Mesa E175於10月26日在Houston發生煞車與轉向問題；United波音737 MAX 9於10月25日在Houston被描述為起落架狀況不安全；香港航空A321neo航程中涉及行動電源熱失控；Jet2波音737-800同日在Birmingham短暫偏出跑道。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Four independent aviation incidents involve aircraft systems, a power bank and runway excursion
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The roundup lists four independent aviation incidents and states no connection between them. A Mesa E175 had brake and steering problems at Houston on October 26; a United Boeing 737 MAX 9 was described as having unsafe landing gear at Houston on October 25; a Hong Kong A321neo incident involved a power bank thermal runaway in flight; and a Jet2 Boeing 737-800 briefly veered off the runway at Birmingham that day.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 國內線午後陸續恢復 民航局協調加開或放大機型25架次
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國內線航班午後陸續恢復，民航局協調航空公司加開班機或放大機型共25架次，包括澎湖航線17架次、金門航線8架次，提供2,251個座位。截至當日18時，仍有159架次取消、20架次延誤；部分金門、澎湖旅客尚未取得機位，民航局提醒先確認座位再前往機場。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan domestic flights resume in the afternoon as CAA coordinates 25 capacity increases
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan domestic flights gradually resumed in the afternoon. The Civil Aeronautics Administration coordinated 25 added flights or larger-aircraft operations—17 on Penghu routes and eight on Kinmen routes—providing 2,251 seats. As of 6 p.m., 159 flights had been canceled and 20 delayed. Some passengers in Kinmen and Penghu still lacked seats, and the agency advised travelers to confirm their bookings before going to the airport.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣虎航發動機檢查管制逾期遭民航局裁罰20萬元
taiwan_aviation.summary: 民航局因臺灣虎航一架A320-271N的二號發動機燃燒室延遲缺點檢查管制逾期，依民航法裁罰新臺幣20萬元，並要求立即改善。臺灣虎航表示，該機去年9月排班時出現管制時間計算落差，公司自主管理檢查發現後當日完成檢查，並已檢討及加強雙重覆核。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Tigerair fined NT$200,000 over overdue engine inspection control
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aviation Administration fined Taiwan Tigerair NT$200,000 under the Civil Aviation Act after the inspection control deadline for a deferred defect in an A320-271N’s No. 2 engine combustion chamber passed. The authority required immediate improvement. The airline said a scheduling time-calculation discrepancy occurred in September last year, was found in an internal review, and the inspection was completed that day; it has since strengthened its dual-check process.

sources.name: 中央社 CNA 國籍航空 — 發動機過期檢查遭罰20萬元 台灣虎航自主發現主動通報

international_aviation.headline: 阿提哈德A380首度飛抵曼谷 開啟每日阿布達比航班
international_aviation.summary: 阿提哈德航空確認，A380-800於10月25日首度抵達曼谷素萬那普機場，開啟每日阿布達比—曼谷A380航班，也是該公司首次以A380執飛泰國。註冊編號A6-APD的客機當地時間上午7時20分抵達，航程約5個半小時。
international_aviation.headline_en: Etihad A380 makes first Bangkok arrival and begins daily Abu Dhabi service
international_aviation.summary_en: Etihad Airways confirmed that its A380-800 arrived at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for the first time on October 25, beginning a daily A380 service between Abu Dhabi and Bangkok. It is the airline’s first A380 service to Thailand. The aircraft, registered A6-APD, arrived at 7:20 a.m. local time after a flight of about five and a half hours.

international_aviation.headline: 波音子公司Spirit Defense將參與FQ-42機身設計與製造
international_aviation.summary: 波音子公司Spirit Defense將成為General Atomics Aeronautical Systems的FQ-42 Vengeance機身設計製造合作夥伴，提供從設計到生產的工程與製造能力。美國空軍於2026年9月確認首批增量涵蓋兩款協同作戰飛機共150架。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing subsidiary Spirit Defense to design and build FQ-42 fuselages
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing subsidiary Spirit Defense will serve as a fuselage design-and-build partner for General Atomics Aeronautical Systems’ FQ-42 Vengeance, providing engineering and manufacturing from design through production. In September 2026, the US Air Force confirmed that the first increment covers 150 aircraft across two collaborative combat aircraft types.

international_aviation.headline: A350-900ULR航程達9,700海里 設計透過移除零件減重
international_aviation.summary: A350-900ULR據報航程達9,700海里。相關說明指出，這項航程表現並非單靠增加燃油容量，而是透過移除零件減輕重量；文中未提供更多具體設計細節。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus A350-900ULR reaches 9,700 nautical miles through parts removal
international_aviation.summary_en: The Airbus A350-900ULR is reported to have a range of 9,700 nautical miles. The account says this range is achieved not simply by increasing fuel capacity, but also by removing parts to reduce weight; it provides no further specific design details.

international_aviation.headline: SITA同意收購CAE航空運營軟體業務Flightscape
international_aviation.summary: SITA已同意收購CAE的航空運營軟體業務Flightscape。該軟體可協助航空公司規劃航班、管理機組、營運控制中心、協調地面活動及提供機上服務；SITA表示每日有超過90家航空公司使用。交易預計於2027年上半年完成，仍須符合一般交割條件並取得監管批准，財務條款未披露。
international_aviation.headline_en: SITA agrees to acquire CAE’s Flightscape airline operations software business
international_aviation.summary_en: SITA has agreed to acquire CAE’s airline operations software business, Flightscape. The software supports flight planning, crew management, operations control, coordination of ground activities and in-flight services; SITA says more than 90 airlines use it daily. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Financial terms were not disclosed.

international_aviation.headline: 法羅群島大西洋航空再訂兩架A320neo 推進全A320neo機隊轉型
international_aviation.summary: 法羅群島大西洋航空與空中巴士簽署確定訂單，再購兩架A320neo，推進機隊全面轉型。該航空公司目前營運四架A320家族客機，包括兩架A320ceo及兩架A320neo；公司稱新訂單是邁向全A320neo機隊的重要一步。
international_aviation.headline_en: Atlantic Airways orders two more A320neos to move toward an all-A320neo fleet
international_aviation.summary_en: Faroe Islands flag carrier Atlantic Airways has signed a firm order with Airbus for two more A320neo aircraft, advancing its transition toward an all-A320neo fleet. The airline currently operates four A320 Family aircraft: two A320ceos and two A320neos. Atlantic Airways said the agreement marks an important step toward an exclusively A320neo fleet.
